messages:
Incident Bot: [P1] High error-rate on /v1/generate (us-west-2) — paging oncall @Priya (oncall) 1912509999
Priya (oncall): seeing a spike in 5xxs, sending initial triage. marking Synapse Health as potentially impacted (enterprise dedicated).
Alex M: confirmed — Synapse Health traffic is routing through dedicated pool 'synapse-dedicated-01'. Their SLA requires priority comms. tagging @Julie C for CS notify.
Sara O: digging into runtime logs now — KV cache evictions + increased tail latency around 1912509600. could be memory pressure after a batch size bump.
Marco S: I saw a deploy to runtime pool at 1912509500? @eng-oncall any deploys rolled in recently?
Priya (oncall): no deploys on our side in the last 2 hours. looks infra-y. running `redis-cli MONITOR` and checking gpu-agent logs.
Incident Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-01 — Priority: P1 — Services: inference-runtime, routing. Linked: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-0423-01
Julie C: preparing tailored customer notice. Synapse Health is on our enterprise routing list (account id syn-0042). Contact routing: primary: eng-ops@synapsehealth.com (pager), backup: csm@redwood.com. Did we reach their SRE slack?
Alex M: yes — Synapse SRE Slack handle: @synapse-sre. I DM'ed them, no reply yet. Sending SMS via SSO as well.
Sara O: stack trace sample from gpu-agent: 
```
2026-04-23T12:40:33Z gpu-agent[pid=824] WARN KVCache eviction threshold exceeded
2026-04-23T12:40:34Z runtime[pid=4312] ERROR write timeout -> upstream: 502
```
Marco S: probable root cause: aggressive batching parameter applied to the pool by Optimize job. rolling back batching config to previous value.
Priya (oncall): rolling back now. ETA 3m. will monitor error rate.
(3 minutes later)
Priya (oncall): rollback applied. error-rate dropping from 14% -> 1.6% over last minute. continuing to monitor.
StatusBot: Status page draft ready for review: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0423-01/draft
Alex M: posting customer-facing status update (short) — please review: 
> Customers on our dedicated and enterprise routing may experience elevated error rates for text generation in us-west-2. We are investigating and applying mitigation. Expected next update in 15 minutes.
Julie C: Synapse-specific email template (please review before send): 
```
Subject: Incident affecting Synapse Health — text generation in us-west-2
Hi <Customer Contact>,\nWe are investigating an issue impacting text generation for Synapse Health routed through our dedicated pool. You may observe increased errors (502/504) and higher latency. Our team has applied an immediate mitigation and is monitoring. We will follow up within 30 minutes with next steps and any required remediation.
If you need immediate assistance, please reply to this email or contact your CSM on Slack @Julie_CS.
— Redwood Support
```
Marco S: proposed internal postmortem note snippet for leadership: 
```
Impact: Synapse Health experienced elevated errors for 22 minutes impacting dedicated pool synapse-dedicated-01.
Actions: rolled back Optimize batching config; monitored until error rates returned to baseline.
Next steps: add canary for batching config changes, expand observability on KV cache evictions, schedule postmortem w/ Synapse SRE.
```
Priya (oncall): handoff in 30 mins to @Alex M (next oncall). leaving notes in the incident channel and runbook pointer: runbook/ref: /runbooks/dedicated-pool-memory-pressure.md
Alex M: I'll take the handoff and coordinate with CS to send tailored Synapse follow-up. Julie — please hold the customer email until I confirm post mitigation metrics.
Julie C: acknowledged — draft on hold. preparing escalation list: 
- Synapse Health primary SRE: eng-ops@synapsehealth.com
- Synapse Health exec contact: exec@synapsehealth.com
- Redwood CSM: julie@redwood.ai
- Redwood Customer Success Pager: +1-555-0102 (SMS)
Priya (oncall): final internal status update to post in #incidents before handoff: 
> INC-2026-0423-01 — mitigated. Rolling rollback of batching completed. Error rate reduced to ~1.5%. Synapse Health impacted briefly. Leaving to Alex for monitoring and follow-up.
Alex M: taking over. I'll post the public status page update and coordinate a 1:1 with Synapse SRE to review impact. Assigning follow-ups: 
- Marco: expand KV cache metrics (owner: Marco)
- Sara: validate no data loss and run regression testing (owner: Sara)
- Julie: customer follow-up and exec notification if requested (owner: Julie)
Incident Bot: note: schedule postmortem meeting (30m) and send calendar invite to participants.
Julie C: sending Synapse the short notice now (cc: CSM + exec). will attach our internal timeline and next steps.
(End of thread)
